style_presets.name: Friendly Editorial Cartoon
style_presets.prompt:
Create a 16:9 scene populated with 10+ characters of widely varying ages, heights, and silhouettes. Include an elderly person, a young lanky person, a short middle-aged person, a tall slim person, a bald person, a short older person with glasses, a muscular younger person, and a nervous teenager. Characters should appear in natural everyday poses: standing, walking, chatting, sitting, leaning, gesturing, observing, and interacting casually within the scene.

All characters must share this exact unified art style:

Clean 2D cartoon animation
Chunky rounded body proportions
Large circular heads scaled to body size
Small centered facial features
Simple dot eyes with subtle eyelid lines
Tiny red-tipped noses
Minimal mouth shapes with varied expressions (neutral, smiling, frowning, talking, surprised)
Bold black outlines
Flat cel-shaded colors with a single subtle shadow pass
No gradients
No textures
No painterly rendering
No photorealism

Skin tones should be warm neutral medium tones with only subtle variation between characters, keeping all appearances ethnically ambiguous and friendly. Hair colors vary naturally between black, brown, gray, and white.

Color palette:

Muted navy blues
Warm beige and tan tones
Cool grays
Soft desaturated accent colors only where needed

Height variation should be dramatic, with the shortest character reaching only the shoulder height of the tallest. Character silhouettes should be clearly distinct through age, posture, proportions, hairstyle, clothing details, accessories, and personality cues rather than body size.

Environment should be a bright, clean, modern public interior space with simple architectural elements, benches, wall panels, signage, lighting fixtures, and everyday objects that help establish scale and activity. Bright flat even lighting, highly readable composition, strong character silhouettes, appealing visual clarity, and polished YouTube-thumbnail-quality presentation. The focus is on showcasing the character design system and unified art style rather than any specific setting.

style_presets.name: Stick Guys
style_presets.prompt:
Create a 16:9 scene populated with 10+ characters of varying ages and heights, standing and milling around in natural everyday poses: standing, walking, chatting, sitting, leaning, gesturing, observing, and interacting casually within the scene.
All characters must share this exact unified art style:

Simple 2D minimalist cartoon. Large circular white/light heads with thin black outlines. Bare thin black stick-line limbs (arms and legs) with no hands or feet detail. Simple flat-colored rectangular or trapezoid torso shapes, no neck. Small centered facial features: short flat line eyebrows, simple dot eyes, no nose, a short flat or slightly curved line mouth. Minimal varied expressions (neutral, smiling, frowning, talking, surprised) using only simple line changes. Thin, consistent black outlines throughout. Flat solid colors only, no shading, no gradients, no textures, no painterly rendering, no photorealism.
Skin/head color should stay a consistent light neutral tone across all characters, keeping them simple and ethnically ambiguous. Hair, when present, is a simple flat shape in black, brown, gray, or white.
Color palette:

Muted navy blues. Warm beige and tan tones. Cool grays. Soft desaturated accent colors only where needed.
Height variation should be moderate. Characters should read as a friendly, uniform group rather than individually distinct — similar simple clothing shapes, minimal accessories, and no strong personality cues, so the emphasis stays on the shared minimal stick-limb style rather than individual character design.
